issue.title: A completed run whose assigned bead is still open is recorded as plain success, and wait_checks never flags bead waits on it
issue.description: Nothing checks the bead post-condition when a run ends: a phase agent that hits an external blocker (PyPI release, red host-wide gate) records a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, leaves its bead in_progress, and exits green. Dependents waiting on the bead stall indefinitely and no alert fires, because _identity_terminal_blocker in sase_chop_wait_checks.py requires a done marker with a non-success outcome. Overnight 2026-09-17 this idled apollo ~6h: sase-zr.7.1.1.5.4.1 note #1 (23:50 EDT) recorded the PyPI 0.34.50 floor blocker and kept the bead open; .4.2 and .4.land waited until a manual epic rerun at 05:42 closed it (the rerun closed on the same evidence - close criteria are unbounded model judgement). Same mechanism holds sase-11h.4, sase-11i.6.4, sase-11o.2 open 2-3 days. Fix direction: runner post-condition after a completed run with an assigned phase/land bead - open bead + no live family handoff + not explicitly blocked => record completed_blocked (not success) and raise one actionable EpicStalled notification. Pairs with a first-class 'sase bead block --on release|global-gate|human' state.

task_type_fields.impact: Silent overnight epic stalls requiring 3 AM human intervention; three epics stalled 2-3 days undetected
task_type_fields.repro: Have a phase agent leave its assigned bead open with a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP and finish normally; observe dependents WAITING forever with no notification (sase-zr.7.1.1.5.4.1, 2026-09-17 23:50 EDT)
